questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb to complete the sentence: 'If I _____ more time, I would travel around the world.'
Which sentence correctly uses the present perfect tense?
options: She has finished her homework yesterday.
She has finished her homework since yesterday.
She has been finished her homework yesterday.
questions.answer: She has finished her homework since yesterday.

questions.question: Identify the correct comparative form: 'My sister is _____ than I am.'
Which conditional sentence correctly describes a hypothetical situation in the future?
options: If it rains tomorrow, the match will be cancelled.
If it rains tomorrow, the match would be cancelled.
If it rains tomorrow, the match might be cancelled.
If it rains tomorrow, the match could be cancelled.
questions.answer: If it rains tomorrow, the match would be cancelled.

questions.question: Select the correct modal verb for the meaning of ability: 'I can't swim. I need to _____ lessons.'
Which option correctly uses the gerund or infinitive after the verb 'decide'?
options: I decided to study English for a year.
I decided study English for a year.
I decided to study English for a year.
I decided about study English for a year.
questions.answer: I decided to study English for a year.

questions.question: Choose the appropriate linker to complete the sentence: 'The movie was interesting _____ the acting was poor.'
Which word best completes this sentence: 'The new restaurant is _____ than the old one; the food is better and the service is faster.'
Identify the correct form of the verb in the third conditional sentence: 'If I _____ harder, I _____ the exam.'
Which sentence correctly uses the present perfect continuous tense?
options: I have been living in London for five years.
I am living in London for five years.
I lived in London for five years.
I will have been living in London for five years.
questions.answer: I have been living in London for five years.
